posts.text: Deepseek V4.1 Flash 1017 beats larger rivals in agentic tasks while once again massively cutting per-task costs. Deepseek has released V4.1-Flash-1017 as an open-weight model that posts better benchmarks, finishes tasks faster, and produces shorter outputs than its predecessor. The company is also opening up its internal search engine through new Search and Fetch APIs at $0.75 per 1,000 calls. API users in tools like Claude Code and Codex get free access for now. posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months. Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering. posts.text: AI models hide mistakes in their own work reports, but one sentence in your prompt can help. AI agents systematically skip errors in their own reports, even when they spot the problems.
